stories.title: US Federal Reserve plans to raise bank oversight thresholds, sources say

en.title: US Federal Reserve plans to raise bank oversight thresholds, sources say
en.summary: The Federal Reserve intends to propose raising the asset threshold for banking regulations from $700 billion to approximately $960 billion. The change would reduce compliance costs for banks, though analysts warn it may accelerate consolidation among mid-sized banks and increase financial sector risks.

en.title: Sebi bans Omaxe, 5 others for violating minimum public shareholding norms
en.summary: India's securities regulator has banned Omaxe and five related entities for breaching public shareholding requirements through share repurchases using various mechanisms. Omaxe received a three-month market access ban while the others face one-year restrictions, along with substantial fines.
